systems.country_label: Recensement Administratif à Vocation d'Identification des Personnes (RAVIP)
systems.tiers: National identification campaign expanded in 2019; about 350,000 biometric cards procured at the end of 2019 for the poor in remote locations; about 2.5 million registrants to be given birth certificates under the ARCH project
Issued since 1992 to citizens aged 18 and over
As of March 2020 generated from the paper-based national ID
Aims to link the civil registration system to human development and financial services

note: The Benin chapter describes civil registration only institutionally (the Ministry of Interior and Public Security solely responsible, birth registration under 50 per cent, registration centres hard to reach in rural areas) and names no digital system at civil registration offices; its dated statements of paper concern the identity card, not the civil register.
